jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing to build Almetra's marketing function from the ground up. This is a full-stack ownership role — from defining our positioning and narrative to building the initial demand engine and setting the foundation for future scale.

You will work directly with the founders and GTM leadership to shape how the market understands Deltia, create repeatable demand motions, and build the early marketing team over time.

What you’ll do

  • Own positioning and messaging across all customer-facing surfaces

  • Build and execute the go-to-market strategy across digital, content, events and partnerships

  • Design and run demand generation / ABM programs that convert into revenue

  • Create high-leverage content, case studies, and thought leadership with founders and customers

  • Establish marketing metrics, reporting cadence and operational rhythm

  • Gradually build and lead the marketing team as the function scales

You are

  • 5–10 years in B2B SaaS or deep-tech marketing, ideally with enterprise or industrial customer experience

  • Full-stack: strong at both narrative/positioning and performance/demand execution

  • Experienced in building marketing foundations from zero, not just optimizing an existing machine

  • Comfortable working directly with founders and sales to rapidly test and iterate messaging

  • Capable of transitioning from hands-on execution to team leadership as we scale

Why this role matters

You will define how an emerging industrial AI category is perceived — and lay the GTM foundation for the next phase of Deltia’s growth. This is an opportunity to take full ownership, build from first principles and create an iconic category brand.

#LI-Hybrid

What we offer

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics⚖: We are committed to developing ethical AI software

Don't meet all the requirements?

Almetra is committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, fair, and inclusive. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. We firmly believe that having a team with diverse perspectives only strengthens our company and drives innovation. Our commitment also extends to providing an accessible environment for everyone, including those with disabilities. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the application process or while working with us, and we will do our best to support you.

*Only full-time, permanent roles are eligible for stock options. Part-time roles, contract roles, work-student, internships and freelance roles are not eligible for stock options.

Festanstellung / Vollzeit / Erfurt oder Leipzig, Hybrid / Start: ASAP

Du möchtest Abschlüsse nicht nur erstellen, sondern Accounting-Prozesse in einem internationalen Softwareunternehmen aktiv mitgestalten?

Als Senior Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) übernimmst du Verantwortung für unsere Finanzprozesse und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Abschlüsse zuverlässig, transparent und aussagekräftig sind. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Director Finance & Legal zusammen und entwickelst unsere Prozesse Schritt für Schritt weiter.

Cuculus entwickelt Softwarelösungen für Energieversorger weltweit. Dich erwartet ein internationales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung – und der Möglichkeit, Dinge wirklich voranzubringen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Abschlüsse: Du erstellst eigenständig Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB und IFRS – dabei stellst du die Qualität und Vollständigkeit unserer Finanzdaten sicher.
  • Bewertungen & Abgrenzungen: Du bewertest Rückstellungen und Vorräte und stellst periodengerechte Abgrenzungen sicher.
  • Steuern: Du bereitest Steuererklärungen vor, betreust Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen und begleitest Betriebsprüfungen.
  • Kontenabstimmung & Audits: Du stimmst Haupt- und Nebenbücher ab und arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Auditor:innen zusammen.
  • Laufende Buchhaltung: Du verantwortest die laufende Buchhaltung mit und sorgst für die korrekte Erfassung, Prüfung und Abstimmung der Geschäftsvorfälle – von Debitoren und Kreditoren bis zum Hauptbuch.
  • KI & Automatisierung: Du bringst Ideen ein, wie wir Routinearbeit reduzieren und Finance-Prozesse optimieren können – und setzt dies gemeinsam mit dem Director Finance & Legal um.


Dein Profil

  • Accounting-Erfahrung: Mindestens fünf Jahre im Accounting mit Abschlussverantwortung. 
  • Qualifikation: Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK), kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder vergleichbar. Erfahrung aus einer Steuerberatung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • HGB & IFRS: Fundierte Kenntnisse, die du in der Praxis sicher anwendest.
  • Systeme: Excel gehört für dich zum Arbeitsalltag. Sage 100 und Candis sind ein Plus.
  • KI-Affinität: Du nutzt KI-Tools bereits im Arbeitsalltag - oder hast Lust, damit anzufangen.
  • Deutsch & Englisch: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch mit Steuerberatung, Behörden und Auditor:innen. Englisch ist bei uns Voraussetzung – du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld und stimmst dich auch dort sicher ab.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, setzt selbstständig Prioritäten und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Du möchtest nicht einfach bestehende Prozesse verwalten, sondern deinen Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mitgestalten.


Warum wir?

Wir glauben, dass gute Arbeit Verantwortung, Vertrauen und den nötigen Freiraum braucht. Deshalb bekommst du bei Cuculus die Möglichkeit, deine Expertise einzubringen und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Finance-Bereichs aktiv mitzugestalten.

jobs.title: Senior GenAI Solution Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
What you can expect from us

We are a technical, implementation-oriented spin-off of a global management consultancy. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies, which we advise on issues in the areas of analytics, big data and machine learning. Within the group, we take on the development of individual and data-driven solutions in order to transform our clients into AI-powered companies. We offer an international working environment with agile teams and creative startup methods as well as above-average remuneration and numerous additional benefits. With our offices in Hamburg, Munich and Düsseldorf and our hub locations in all other major German cities (Berlin, Frankfurt and Stuttgart), we ensure that all colleagues are integrated into our team of experts across Germany.

Your role as a Senior GenAI Solution Engineer:

  • End-to-End Development: You drive AI solutions across the full lifecycle - from rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept to deployment in scalable, highly available production environments.
  • AI Services Engineering: You build robust backend services in Python that seamlessly integrate state-of-the-art LLMs and perform reliably under production load.
  • Autonomous Agent Architecture: You design and implement intelligent agent systems that automate real-world workflows through tool calling and memory management, operating safely within defined guardrails.
  • Agentic SDLC: You integrate AI agents into the development lifecycle - from AI-assisted coding and code reviews to automated testing and intelligent documentation - enhancing efficiency across the entire software development process through agentic tools.
  • Ensuring Software Excellence: You take ownership of code quality by applying clean architecture principles, implementing automated testing, and establishing efficient CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth and reliable deployments.
  • Evaluation & Monitoring: You implement frameworks to measure the performance of GenAI solutions (e.g., accuracy, latency, cost) and ensure continuous optimization.
  • Consulting: You work directly with clients - facilitating workshops and acting as a sparring partner for business and management stakeholders. You translate complex AI concepts into tangible business impact and co-create the right solutions.
  • Technology Sparring: You assess technical feasibility and advise stakeholders on how to turn innovative ideas into sustainable, production-ready products.


Who you are

  • Excellent Python Skills (Production-Ready): You have strong expertise in API development (e.g., FastAPI, Pydantic), containerization (Docker), testing (unit and integration), as well as Git and CI/CD - well beyond notebook-based scripting.
  • Rapid Prototyping: Ability to quickly build and visualize demos and proof-of-concepts.
  • Strong Architectural Understanding: You apply SOLID principles, Clean Architecture, dependency injection, and async/concurrency patterns in a structured way, and leverage ORMs (e.g., SQLAlchemy) for clean and efficient database interactions.
  • Hands-on Experience with Multimodal LLM APIs: Proficient in working with leading models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).
  • Advanced GenAI Engineering: Strong command of prompt engineering, structured outputs (JSON), and tool/function calling.
  • RAG Expertise (End-to-End): Experience in building full pipelines - from embeddings and vector databases (e.g., pgvector) to advanced retrieval, re-ranking, and evaluation.
  • Agent Development: Experience in designing and orchestrating autonomous systems (e.g., with Pydantic AI), including memory management and guardrails.
  • Consulting Skills: Experience working directly with clients. You are able to facilitate workshops, present results, and confidently navigate complex stakeholder environments.
  • Languages: Fluent in German (C1), with professional proficiency in English.
  • Education: Completed degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a comparable field (Bachelor’s degree or higher).
  • Willingness to travel: You are willing to work on-site at the client’s premises on a regular basis


Who we are

  • Shape the future with (Gen)AI by working on diverse and impactful projects at the intersection of strategy, technology, and business.
  • Work flexibly in a way that suits your life – with hybrid working models, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home.
  • Enjoy an open, collaborative culture with flat hierarchies, an international team, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge and support one another.
  • A Great Place to Grow: Benefit from tailored learning opportunities, individualized career paths, and dedicated support for your professional and personal development.
  • Be part of a strong international network of more than 1,300 colleagues and enjoy regular cross-office and international company events.

  • 5+ Jahre in Cloud, Data, Software oder ML Engineering – davon 2+ Jahre mit Ownership für End-to-End-Architekturen

Bei Auvaria bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass Performance nur unter den richtigen Bedingungen gelingen kann:

jobs.title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.



Skip the Queue

Told you it was worth reading to the end.


We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly.

This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents nobody has seen before – and you'll set the technical direction for how the team navigates that trade-off, deciding where to push automation further and where human review still matters.


Your Mission

jobs.title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Karriere

Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht.

Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen.

Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. 

Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht.

Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Konzeption, Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von KI-gestützten Softwarelösungen – von der ersten Idee bis in den stabilen Produktivbetrieb
  • Agentic Engineering: Entwurf und Umsetzung agentischer Systeme – Tool- und Function-Calling, Orchestrierung mehrstufiger Workflows, Kontext- und State-Management, Retries und Fallbacks, Human-in-the-Loop und sinnvolle Guardrails
  • Design und Umsetzung von LLM-Anwendungen: RAG-Pipelines, strukturierte Extraktion, Evaluation, Observability
  • Integration von ML-Modellen, Foundation Models und datengetriebenen Services in bestehende oder neue Systeme – inklusive der APIs, Datenflüsse und Infrastruktur drumherum
  • Hands-on-Entwicklung skalierbarer, wartbarer und performanter Anwendungen auf modernen Technologien und Cloud-Plattformen (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry o. ä.)
  • Identifikation von KI-Use-Cases in Kundenprojekten – und die ehrliche Einschätzung, wann ein Agent die richtige Antwort ist und wann eine deterministische Lösung die bessere
  • Agentic Coding im eigenen Arbeitsalltag: KI-Werkzeuge produktiv und verantwortungsvoll in Entwicklung, Review und Delivery einsetzen – und dem Team zeigen, wie es geht
  • Technologische Beratung unserer Kunden bei Architektur-, Technologie- und Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen
  • Sicherstellung von Code-Qualität durch Clean Code, Tests, Reviews und Best Practices
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung unseres wachsenden KI-Kompetenzfelds – Themen setzen, Wissen ins Team tragen, Standards etablieren


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der modernen Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Fullstack-Umfeld – du bist und bleibst Entwickler <3
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und generativer KI in echten Projekten: Prompting, RAG, Embeddings/Vektor-Datenbanken, Function Calling, Fine-Tuning oder Agenten-Frameworks. 
  • Erfahrung oder ernsthaftes Interesse an Agentic Engineering – du hast schon einmal einen Agenten über den Demo-Status hinaus gebracht oder brennst darauf, es zu tun
  • Solides Verständnis von ML-Grundlagen und Datenverarbeitung – du weißt, was ein Modell leisten kann und wo seine Grenzen liegen
  • Cloud-Entwicklung mit AWS und/oder Azure, inklusive CI/CD, Containern und Infrastructure as Code
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Clean Code, SOLID-Prinzipien und der Gestaltung sauberer Softwarearchitekturen
  • Selbstständige, verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise mit stark ausgeprägten analytischen und konzeptionellen Fähigkeiten
  • Die Fähigkeit, pragmatische Lösungen für komplexe Anforderungen zu entwickeln – und über den Tellerrand hinaus zu denken
  • Hohe Motivation und Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung und für ein Technologiefeld, das sich monatlich neu erfindet
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) in Wort und Schrift, sowie gute Englischkenntnisse
Nice to have:
Da wir als Dienstleister mit unterschiedlichen Kunden und Projekten arbeiten, freuen wir uns über Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche:
Frameworks
  • Angular
  • .NET
  • NestJS
Programmiersprachen
  • C#
  • TypeScript
  • Python
Infrastruktur & Cloud
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform und/oder CDK
Du musst nicht alles davon mitbringen – wichtiger ist uns deine Senior-Erfahrung, deine Lernbereitschaft und deine Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Technologien und Projektumgebungen einzuarbeiten.


Was bieten wir Dir?

Einheit: AI Engineering
Level: Senior
Arbeitsvolumen: Vollzeit

Einige unserer Benefits:

  • Tech, Ownership & Impact
    • Architektur mitgestalten: Du triffst technische Entscheidungen, setzt Engineering-Standards und übernimmst Verantwortung für langlebige Systemdesigns.
    • Makers Lab: Neben Kundenprojekten entwickelst du interne Tools und Lösungen, die uns wirklich weiterbringen. Wenn eine Idee gut ist, setzten wir sie um.

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing & Creator Manager (all genders), 100 % Home-Office
jobs.description:
Wann hast du zuletzt aus einem YouTube-Kanal einen SPIEGEL-Bestseller gemacht?

Bei uns ist das der Job. BrainBook macht Bücher mit einigen der größten Gaming-YouTuber Deutschlands, zum Beispiel LukasBS und EinfachGustaf: Romane, Comic-Romane, Reihen, Schwerpunkt Leser zwischen 8 und 14. Sechs Jahre alt, komplett remote, kein Gremium, kein Warten. Wir wirbeln eine Branche auf, die sich seit dreißig Jahren kaum bewegt hat, und nächstes Jahr bringen wir 16 Titel raus.

Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unsere Creator durch ihr Buchprojekt führt: vom ersten Konzept über den Launch bis zu dem Moment, in dem die Community das Buch in den Händen hält. Du kennst die Kanäle, du sprichst die Kampagne mit Creator und Management ab, du sorgst dafür, dass Marketingmaterial, Bonusmaterial und Integrationen rechtzeitig stehen, und du entwickelst mit unserer Programmleitung die nächsten Projekte. Organisiert genug, dass Deadlines halten. Nah genug an der Szene, dass Creator dir vertrauen.

Wenn du in deiner Agentur oder deinem Team die Person bist, die Creator anrufen, wenn es wichtig wird: Wir sollten reden.

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust unsere Creator und ihre Managements über den gesamten Projektverlauf: Du kennst ihre Kanäle, ihre Community und ihre Pläne, bist die erste Ansprechperson für alles rund um Launch und Marketing und hältst den Kontakt, bis das Buch draußen ist, und darüber hinaus.
  • Du sprichst die Kampagne mit Creator und Management ab: Marketing-Calls, Integrationsplan mit Long-Form- und Short-Form-Formaten, Ankündigungs- und Launch-Termine. Du hältst den Plan nach, fasst nach, wenn etwas fehlt, und wertest jede Kampagne mit den relevanten KPIs aus, von Views und Watchtime bis zu Klicks und Verkäufen je Integration.
  • Du bereitest jeden Launch vor: Timeline von der Ankündigung bis zum Erscheinungstermin, Vorbestellung, Gewinnspiele, Aktionen im Shop, auf Amazon und im TikTok Shop, gemeinsam mit Lektorat, Design und den Kanal-Verantwortlichen.
  • Du organisierst das komplette Marketingmaterial mit dem Creator und unserem Design-Team: Teaser- und Shorts-Konzepte, Produktbilder, Briefings, Creator-Boxen, Autogrammkarten, Dummy-Drucke und Bonusmaterial wie Poster, Maps oder Texture Packs. Du briefst Design-Team und externe Kreative, steuerst Revisionen und holst die Freigabe des Creators ein. Gestaltet wird im Design-Team, du hältst die Fäden.
  • Du verantwortest das Launch-Budget je Buch und beauftragst Freelancer und Material eigenständig innerhalb dieses Budgets.
  • Du entwickelst mit unserer Programmleitung Konzepte für neue Creator, bereitest Pitches und Angebote vor, gehst mit in Erstgespräche mit Creatorn und Managements und pflegst den Austausch mit der Szene auf Messen und Events. Verträge und Konditionen verhandelt unser Geschäftsführer.
  • Du stimmst dich eng mit unserer Produktion, unserer Redaktion und unserem Design-Team ab, damit Buch, Material und Kampagne zusammenkommen, hältst Absprachen und Termine in ClickUp fest und lieferst jeden Freitag einen klaren Statusreport zu allen laufenden Launches.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Influencer Marketing, im Creator- oder Talent-Management oder im Kampagnen- und Projektmanagement, auf Agentur- oder Markenseite oder in einem Creator-Management. Mehr ist ausdrücklich willkommen.
  • Du hast schon mit Creatorn und ihren Managements gearbeitet: Briefings, Freigaben, Termine, Nachfassen, auch wenn es hakt. Du bleibst dabei freundlich und verbindlich, schriftlich wie im Call.
  • Du kennst Long-Form und Short-Form aus der Praxis: Ein YouTube-Video mit Integration funktioniert anders als ein Short, ein TikTok oder ein Reel, und du weißt, welches Format welchen Job im Launch übernimmt.
  • Du weißt, welche KPIs heute zählen und was sie bedeuten: Views, Watchtime und Retention bei Long-Form, Aufrufe, Completion Rate und Shares bei Short-Form, dazu Klicks, Conversion und Verkäufe je Integration. Aus einem Report leitest du eine Entscheidung ab, nicht nur eine Grafik.
  • Du kannst einen Kanal lesen: Zielgruppe, Formate, Reichweite, Qualität der Integrationen. Und du kannst daraus eine Kampagnen- oder Produktidee ableiten.
  • Du hast mehrere Kampagnen oder Launches parallel mit festen Deadlines gesteuert und kannst konkret erzählen, was dabei schiefging und was du daraus gemacht hast.
  • Du kennst die Kennzeichnungsregeln für Creator-Content und weißt, was bei Gewinnspielen und einer Zielgruppe unter 14 zu beachten ist.
  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch gut in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du arbeitest im Home-Office selbstorganisiert, bist ein paar Mal im Jahr auf Messen und Events unterwegs, baust saubere Präsentationen und bist sicher in ClickUp oder einem vergleichbaren Tool, in einem CRM wie HubSpot und in Google Workspace oder Microsoft 365.
  • Ein Plus, kein Muss: Du bringst schon ein Netzwerk in der Creator-Szene mit, Creator, Managements, Agenturen.

Kein Ausschluss: Du musst nicht aus dem Buchmarkt kommen. Bücher, Buchhandel und Verlagsprozesse bringen wir dir bei. Was du mitbringst, ist das Gespür für Creator und ihre Communities und die Organisation, damit aus einer Idee ein Launch wird. Gaming- und Kids-Content-Affinität ist ein Plus.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
  • Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
  • Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
  • Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation.
  • Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data.


YOUR PROFILE

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related analytical role, with a track record of turning complex business questions and raw data into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and business decisions
  • Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes, define meaningful metrics, challenge assumptions, and work confidently with imperfect or incomplete data
  • Independent, structured, and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership. You are equally comfortable working with business stakeholders and engineers, communicate clearly across different levels and functions, and can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data
  • Strong business understanding and analytical curiosity, with the ability to quickly grasp the essentials of a complex, finance-driven business, understand how the underlying processes work, and translate business needs into meaningful analytical questions. Experience with financials, commodity trading, finance analytics, or accounting is a strong advantage
  • Strong SQL skills with experience working with complex datasets, data transformations, joins, aggregations, window functions, and analytical data models
  • Proven experience working with modern Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar, including building and maintaining clean, reliable datasets for analysis and reporting
  • Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt, including data modelling, automated data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage
  • Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar), with a focus on building clear, performant dashboards and enabling self-service analytics


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment

jobs.description:
The Role

Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to govern their AI agents safely — and we're growing fast. We're looking for a technical, customer-focused Technical Account Manager to own the post-sale relationship with our customers and make sure they get the best from their Geordie deployment, fast.

You'll be the technical face of Geordie for a portfolio of enterprise accounts — guiding onboarding and integration, becoming the go-to expert customers trust for anything technical, and working closely with our sales, product and engineering teams to keep our customers successful and growing. You will turn technical relationships into lasting partnerships.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll get deep into our platform, our customers' environments, and everything in between — and you'll help shape how Geordie delivers success for our customers as our first UK-based TAM hire.

We also expect you to work the way we build — intelligently and efficiently. That means embracing AI agents in your day-to-day workflows. We use tools like Claude Cowork to move faster and do more. If you're not passionate about that, this probably isn't the right place for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Technical Relationship — Be the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building trust from customer kick-off through renewal and expansion.

  • Project Management — Own the project plan for onboarding and major implementations end-to-end: timelines, milestones, resourcing, and risk tracking across customer, engineering, and product stakeholders. Run the cadence of standups/status calls, keep everyone accountable to dates, and escalate slippage before it becomes a surprise.

  • Onboarding & Implementation — Guide customers through deployment, integrations, and configuration, so they see value from day one.

  • Product Mastery — Become a deep expert on the Geordie platform. Troubleshoot issues, answer technical questions, and give customers confidence in how we work.

  • Adoption & Health — Track account health and usage, spot risks early, and drive the actions that keep customers engaged and expanding.

  • Escalation Management — Be the calm, capable owner of technical escalations — coordinating with engineering and product teams to resolve issues and close the loop with customers.

  • Renewals & Expansion — Partner with our sales team to identify expansion opportunities and ensure strong technical health underpins every renewal opportunity.

  • Customer Advocacy — Bring field insights back to our teams — feature requests, friction points, and what's actually happening in customer environments — so we keep building the right things and ensure the customer remains at the centre of everything we do.

  • Documentation & Enablement — Build the runbooks, guides, and best-practice materials that make onboarding repeatable and support scalable.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with sales, engineering and product teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

  • Build the Function — As our first UK TAM, help shape the processes and playbooks that define how Geordie supports customers as we scale, in step with the wider TAM function.

What We're Looking For

  • You're technical, and you like it. You're comfortable in the details — agents, APIs, integrations, security, governance — and you enjoy figuring out how things really work.

  • You own outcomes. You don't wait — you track account health and get ahead of risk before it becomes a churn conversation.

  • You're a builder. Early-stage means you create structure where there isn't any and find a way to provide value to customers.

  • You're AI-fluent, not just AI-aware. You use tools like Claude Cowork and other agentic AI to run your own workflow — drafting runbooks, triaging tickets, prepping QBRs, chasing account health signals — so you spend your time on judgement calls and relationships, not repetitive admin. You look for the next task to hand off to an agent before you look for the next hire.

  • You earn trust at every level. You can debug an integration issue with an engineer in the morning and brief a CISO on progress in the afternoon, without losing credibility in either room.

  • You listen before you troubleshoot. You ask sharp questions to understand what's actually going on before you propose a fix, then deliver.

  • You communicate clearly and often. Customers always know where things stand.

  • You're focused on success. Not just at renewal time — all the time. You care whether customers succeed, and it shows in how you show up.

  • You embrace new ways of working. You actively use AI tools — especially agents — to work smarter, move faster, and do more. You thrive in ambiguity.

Requirements

  • 2–5 years' experience in a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer role at a SaaS or cybersecurity company.

  • Passion and interest in agents, how organisations are utilising them, their security and risk, and their governance.

  • Solid technical fluency — comfortable with agent architectures, agent security, agent tooling, APIs, SaaS/cloud integrations, and cloud environments.

  • Proven track record of owning post-sale relationships with enterprise customers, including onboarding, adoption, and renewal.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues, including coordinating with engineering teams on fixes.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work confidently with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong discovery and problem-solving skills — able to get to the root of a customer issue quickly.

Building the AI-first frontier enterprise.

We are a global technology consultancy with a trademarked, AI-first approach-Gen-e2™. It redefines how enterprises build digital products and transform their organizations with AI. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We’re proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

  • We are AI-native professionals who invest in what we believe and work as a collective intelligence

  • We are positive, courageous and deliver at the leading edge

Your Role

As Head of Engineering at PALO IT Labs, reporting directly to the CTO, you are the operational engine of our engineering organisation. You translate strategy into daily execution, lead our AI engineering community, and ensure every team-client-facing or product-side-delivers at the highest standard.

Where the CTO sets direction and makes structural architectural decisions, you make those decisions real. You own the day-to-day: team health, engineering standards, roadmap execution, and the development of our AI engineers. You are the technical authority your teams rely on to unblock, challenge and grow-while the CTO focuses on vision, key clients, and long-term positioning.

Engineering Excellence

  • Deploy the Gen-e²™ technology roadmap defined by the CTO: architecture governance, AI governance, and factory standards (agents, prompts, rules, pipelines) across all squads

  • Own the token economics of our delivery, balancing model cost, latency and quality across squads, so “AI-first” means production-grade, not prototype-grade

  • Operate one level above Lead Engineers: arbitrate divergences, challenge local decisions, spot systemic debt and keep the bar rising as execution becomes increasingly agentic

  • Step in as Tech Lead on client projects when needed: if a mission requires it, you can take the technical lead role directly, ensuring continuity and quality without waiting for a resource to be available

  • Define and enforce engineering standards: CI/CD practices, code reviews, incident management, and security posture across squads

  • Own technical incidents and escalations with clear ownership and post-mortems

People & Community

  • Operate the hiring process for engineering roles: sourcing strategy, interviews, technical assessments and recommendations to the CTO

Gen-e2 Practice & R&D

  • Feed everything back into Gen-e²: what you learn on live engagements becomes standards, artefacts, prompts and learning paths for the whole firm, in collaboration with international teams

  • Produce and own engineering KPIs: velocity, quality, incident rate, technical debt, and team health; report regularly to the CTO

  • Represent the engineering practice in leadership forums and working groups, communicate regularly on team health and needs, escalate risks promptly, and uphold PALO IT values, confidentiality, information security and professional standards

  • Contribute to pre-sales through technical scoping, estimation, proposal input and executive-level advisory, ensuring commercial promises remain grounded in production-grade engineering reality

Who You Are

  • You bring 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership of an engineering organisation or practice (VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Head of Tech, or CTO of a scale-up)

  • You have delivered production-grade AI-first systems, LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration-and you think in token economics (cost, latency, quality tradeoffs) as naturally as you think in code. You master AI coding assistants as a force multiplier: you still code, by choice

  • You have led delivery in complex, client-facing environments (consulting, embedded squads, platform modernisation) with real users, real constraints and real accountability

  • You are a proven people developer and manager, with a track record of scaling engineering practices-not just individuals-through mentorship, community-building and hands-on AI adoption

  • You think in systems and write things down: architecture decisions under uncertainty, ADRs, standards that make quality reproducible

  • You lead with care and exigence: high expectations held with accountability in a psychologically safe environment

  • You know how to read team signals early: engagement, workload imbalance, burnout risk, retention risk and under-utilisation, and you act with care, clarity and accountability

  • You care about Tech for Good: sustainability, accessibility and responsible AI are embedded in how you build

  • You are comfortable partnering with HR on hiring strategy, interviews, portfolio reviews, offer decisions and talent-pipeline building through community engagement and events

  • Bilingual French/English, English is mandatory for client and international collaboration

More About PALO IT 

Our mission is to become the most advanced consulting company when it comes to AI-First product and software engineering. 100% of our projects are focused on deploying our Gen-e2 methodology to clients to help them accelerate delivery and scale those new practices.

jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.description:
About Luo

Luo is one of the fastest-growing FX and cross-border payments companies in Africa. We help African businesses pay their international suppliers faster, more transparently, and more competitively than traditional solutions.

Luo has built a sophisticated multi-currency payment infrastructure that constantly generates data related to B2B payments, treasury movements, FX pricing and financial reconciliations.

We are now looking for a head of data to develop the Data function at Luo, and to enable every team to leverage data in their day-to-day operations and decisions. What you will build will impact every department: finance, operations, product, sales, FX trading, treasury.


The role

As head of data, you have three core mandates.

  1. You work closely with the engineering team to help evolve our databases and decide data models.

  2. You work with every business team to understand their data needs in order to deliver the dashboards and data tooling they need to be successful.

  3. You are embedded in every product squad to ensure that new features do not compromise existing data systems, and that the dashboards the company already runs on do not silently break.

This role requires both strong data engineering skills and the ability to communicate effectively with other teams about business needs. You will report directly to the CEO, who will help you prioritize the development of the Data function at Luo.

What you will do

  • Build and own the analytics layer the business runs on: dashboards and steering tools for finance, operations, sales, FX trading, treasury.

  • Help the tech team select and integrate new tools to build Luo's data infrastructure: data lake, data flows, data transformations, dashboarding and reporting pipelines.

  • Make the business teams autonomous. Document data models and train managers to query data within their respective scopes.

  • Review every schema change before it ships, arbitrate the data consequences of product decisions, and guarantee that no existing dashboard or reporting pipeline breaks on product releases.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of experience working in data.

  • Strong SQL expertise. In-depth experience with Postgres is highly appreciated.

  • Strong data tooling experience.

  • Experience with dbt, BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform data ecosystem is appreciated.

  • Experience with fintech data is appreciated (eg. multi-currency systems, FX exchanges, ledger systems, balance logic and financial reconciliations).

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to create clarity around complex data problems.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

jobs.title: 📱 Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
🍿 About Staycation

For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel.

But we see something different.

Behind their doors, hotels hide some of the most extraordinary spaces cities have to offer: breathtaking rooftops with skyline views, world-class spas and pools, bars and restaurants led by visionary chefs, interiors that spark the imagination, and beds so perfect you never want to leave them.

Yet, most of these spaces remain invisible to the people who live just a few streets away.

Staycation was born from a simple belief: the most inspiring places in your city shouldn’t be reserved for tourists. They should be part of your everyday life, an alternative to a dinner-date at a restaurant, a spontaneous midweek escape, or a unique way to celebrate a special moment.

Our mission is to transform hotels into a new form of urban entertainment.

Places people turn to when they want to feel, connect or recharge. Whether it’s 24 hours, 48 hours, or just a few hours, we’re reinventing the way people experience the cities they call home.

Today, Staycation means:

  • 🌍 5 million users in France, the UK, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland

  • 🏨 2,500+ partner hotels among the best 4★, 5★ and iconic palaces

  • ⭐️ 9.3/10 average rating for our experiences

Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be.

✨ The role

We’re hiring a Fullstack Developer to strengthen our Product & Engineering team.

You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers.

Your role will be to turn user problems into reliable product increments, contribute from discovery to production, and balance impact, speed, quality and maintainability.

We’re open to both experienced and senior individual contributors, and we’ll calibrate the scope based on what you have already owned and delivered. You may be stronger in either frontend or backend, but you should be genuinely comfortable contributing across both and motivated to keep growing on the full stack.

You’ll report to the Lead Developer of your squad and be part of the Product team led by Robin, our CTO & Head of Product.

📍 Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy and monitor product features across the frontend and backend.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification.

  • Break down projects into clear increments, estimate your work, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate early when the plan needs to change.

  • Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement.

  • Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt.

  • Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time.

  • Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop.

🧰 Our tech environment

Four products running on a shared stack:

  • The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel.

  • The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes.

  • The hotel extranet, where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots.

  • The internal admin platform, the tool our teams use to run the marketplace.

On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform.

📌 Key results

In your first 3 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows.

  • Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production.

  • Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production.

  • Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement.

  • Build reliable working relationships with Engineering, Product Management and Product Design.

In your first 12 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Own a meaningful product and technical scope within your squad.

  • Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business.

  • Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility.

  • Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team.

  • At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others.

🌍 Location

This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France, with two possible working arrangements:

  • If you are based in the Paris region, you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office.

  • If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month).

🚀 Why join us?

  • Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience.

  • Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey.

  • Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design.

  • Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma.

  • Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working.

  • Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris.

🎯 You’re the ideal candidate if you:

Must-haves

  • Have already shipped and owned meaningful product features in a professional environment. We care more about the scope you have handled than an exact number of years or a specific degree.

  • Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger.

  • Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack, as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack.

  • Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way.

  • Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact.

  • Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design.

  • Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with React Native.

  • Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey.

  • Previous experience working remotely.

  • Comfortable working in English in a professional environment.

⚙️ Hiring process

  • Recruiter interview with Mathieu, our Talent Acquisition Manager (30–45 min)

  • Manager interview with Robin, our CTO & Head of Product, and Charlie, one of our Lead Developers (60 min)

  • Technical interview with Corentin and Joachim, our Tech Leads (60 min)

  • Final meetings with members of our Leadership team (60 min) and your potential future teammates (30 min)

jobs.title: Core platform growth engineering
jobs.description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

We've processed 200,000+ clinical tests across 4 countries with a team of 20. We're growing 10% week over week. And we're still early.

We need engineers who build systems, not features, people who own outcomes end-to-end, orchestrate AI to execute, and raise the bar for everyone around them.

You won't spend your days writing boilerplate. You'll write specs that agents execute, review AI-generated code with a critical eye, and make decisions that compound over time. This is what engineering looks like now. If that excites you, keep reading.

We'll shape the exact scope together, mobile, infra, platform, AI, full-stack, based on where you're strongest and where we need it most.

 
 

What we are looking for:

  • Backend: Membership & payments. A confirmed backend engineer (5+ years) who thrives on designing really reliable data models and services, without over-engineering them. You reach for the simplest model that holds. You'll own the systems membership growth runs on: subscriptions and their lifecycle, checkout and payments, promotions and partner offers.

    We're scaling across the EU, with the complexity that comes with it: new countries, currencies, payment methods, and regulations. This is code where a subtle bug costs real money and real trust. You care that the model is right before the endpoint exists, and that every edge case fails safely.

  • Frontend: Engagement & world-class experience. A confirmed frontend engineer (5+ years) with very good craft and a real sensibility for design. You like things crystal clear for the user, you build neat interfaces, and you don't wait for designs to be ready to propose something delightful.

    You'll own what a first-time visitor meets and what keeps members coming back: the acquisition funnel, onboarding, checkout, the everyday surfaces of the product. Your work has to be delightful and reliable for people who have never heard of us and decide in minutes whether to trust us with their health.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

 

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • You've shipped at least one product from 0→1 and felt the difference between writing code and building a system

  • You have 2 deep areas of expertise and can operate across the full stack when the situation demands it

  • You write specs before you write code — precise enough that an AI agent executes correctly on the first pass

  • You review AI-generated code with the same rigor you'd apply to a junior engineer's PR: edge cases, security gaps, design smell

  • You bias toward shipping. A good decision today beats a perfect one next week

  • You're genuinely interested in health — maybe you track your own biomarkers, or you're just frustrated that healthcare is still reactive

 

We would not be a fit if

  • You need a clearly scoped role before you can operate

  • You measure output in lines of code written

  • You've only worked in large orgs with dedicated infra, QA, and platform teams

  • You optimize for stability over velocity

 

Our current stack

TypeScript monorepo · Next.js · NestJS · PostgreSQL + Prisma · AWS (Terraform, Qovery) · GitHub Actions · Claude Code + Cursor

 

The process

  • Intro call (20 min): culture & role fit.

  • Technical interview (30 min)

  • At-home case study: hands-on project, delivery in 2 days.

  • Deep dive (90 min) and team chat (on-site)

  • Reference calls

 

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

 

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Embedded AI
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you!

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while giving them access to the key financial information they need to make the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

  • 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

  • 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor

  • 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe

  • 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings

  • 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself.

The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot: invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production.

By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI, you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust.

HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI

You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement.

  • You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations.

  • You will contribute directly to our Copilot and Autopilot experiences, including Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

  • You will own the full lifecycle of your solutions: problem framing, data and labeling strategy, baselines, training, evaluation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring and maintenance.

  • You will turn user corrections and production failures into better datasets, models and product behavior.

  • You will define quality metrics that reflect real user value: precision and recall, automation coverage, straight-through processing, human correction rate, latency and cost.

  • You will partner with Product, Engineering and accounting experts to understand workflows, define what “correct” means and integrate ML naturally into the user experience.

  • You will choose the simplest reliable approach for each problem — deterministic logic, classical ML, deep learning or generative AI — rather than starting from a preferred model.

  • You will help improve our shared ML engineering practices: reusable components, experimentation, observability, data quality and reliable training and inference pipelines.

  • You will stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging ML and AI techniques — including multimodal and generative models — and applying them when they create measurable value.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn about Pennylane, our users, our accounting workflows and our AI vision during onboarding.

  • You will get familiar with our ML stack, production systems, datasets, metrics and ways of working.

  • You will meet your product and engineering partners and contribute to a first scoped improvement.

Within 3 months:

  • You will own an Embedded AI use case end to end, with clear offline and production metrics.

  • You will have shipped a meaningful improvement to a Copilot or Autopilot capability.

  • You will be comfortable with our technical stack, including Python, Pytorch, PySpark, Redshift, Airflow, AWS SageMaker and our monitoring tools.

  • You will use real user feedback and error analysis to prioritize the next iterations.

Within 6 months:

  • You will lead larger cross-team ML projects and help shape the Embedded AI roadmap.

  • You will improve the reliability, automation coverage and maintainability of one or more production systems.

  • You will share best practices and raise the bar for ML engineering, evaluation and production ownership across the team.

And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company

This means opportunities to mentor new team members, lead major product initiatives and help define the technical standards that make trusted AI possible at Pennylane.

Who are we looking for?

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5–8 years of experience and are very strong in Python.

  • Have hands-on experience building and operating machine learning systems at scale in production — not only training models or running notebooks.

  • Know how to frame an ambiguous product problem, establish a baseline and select useful metrics before optimizing a model.

  • Have strong experience in several of these areas: document AI, NLP, classification, ranking, recommendation, anomaly detection, deep learning or generative AI.

  • Care about data quality, observability, failure modes, cost and long-term maintainability as much as model performance.

  • Have a balanced blend of technical, business and product skills, and communicate well with software engineers, product managers and non-technical domain experts.

  • Are fluent in English; French is not mandatory.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accounting, fintech or other high-trust business workflows.

  • Experience with human-in-the-loop systems, active learning or learning from user corrections.

  • Experience running ML systems at scale with strict latency, reliability or cost constraints.

  • Familiarity with multimodal or generative models for document understanding.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  • A case study interview covering problem framing, data, modeling, evaluation, deployment and monitoring (75 min)

  • A past project interview to discuss your experience and technical decisions (60 min)

  • An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (30 min)
